title: Crawlers Saw an Empty Page - Now 12 Articles Render Live | vitalii.no
description:
Search engine crawlers opening /news and /blog found an empty shell - every article was fetched by the browser after the page had already loaded, so there was nothing in the raw HTML for a bot to index. Quietly compounding the problem, the view counter on individual articles had been frozen since May 2026: the anonymous client's update query never actually passed row-level security, and an ISR cache hid the fact that the numbers had stopped moving for months.

page.tsx for both listings now loads the first 12 articles and the tag bar on the server, with a 10-minute ISR revalidation window, and emits an ItemList JSON-LD block so search engines see structured data on arrival. The listing client components skip their own first fetch entirely and just apply the active language locally, so switching between English, Norwegian and Ukrainian no longer triggers a refetch. For the frozen counter, the dead client-side increments were removed outright; a nightly script now pulls real per-path page loads from Cloudflare's analytics into a new daily table, and a database function adds those numbers on top of the old frozen count instead of trying to reset it.

The first 12 articles on /news and /blog are now present in the raw server HTML for any crawler, and view counts are moving again for the first time since May 2026 - built from real page-load data instead of a broken client-side write.
